title: ULTRAKILL Coin
description: Changes the gold nugget texture to the coin from ULTRAKILL. That's it. Made to be used with ricoshot mod.
body: This pack adds the coin texture from the game ULTRAKILL to replace the gold nugget. This pack is made to be used with the [ricoshot](https://modrinth.com/mod/ricoshot) mod because it uses the gold nugget for the ricoshot mechanic. Feel free to use this with anything including content and mod packs if you would like to.
